CARE COORDINATION NOTE (S.O.A.P.) Prairie Endocrine & Diabetes Associates 09/05/2073 Tue Patient: Mahlet Gebremariam DOB 7/2/2018 MRN E-0498127 Age 55 Coordinator: Beth Cook, RN CDCES Endocrinologist: Dr. Lowell Frost
S: Pt seen in the ED yesterday (9/4) at Meridian Prairie Medical Center for chest tightness + panic, home glucose 70s. D/c'd same day. Daughter Selam called our line at 08:12 and put husband Dawit on, hes worried abt "low sugar" bc the ED sheet says HbA1c 3.0. Per Selam, pt is sleeping badly since mid-August, worried about her sister Tsega Tesfaye in Seattle and a letter from immigration. No falls, no syncope. Takes tacrolimus "the white capsules" every morning.
O: ED data: BP 101/72, wt 86.5 kg, BMI 28.9, pain 3/10, glucose 77.3, GAD-7 = 7 (mild), depression screen done, social needs screen done. HbA1c 3.0 again - was 3.2 on 10/19/71 and 2.8 on 10/24/72. Values this low do not fit with glucoses 65-100 on file and are NOT credible, likely assay problem / altered red cell survival after transplant (not Hashimoto-related or thyroid, TSH was normal). Tremor noted by ED RN - typical of tacrolimus, not Parkinson's disease. Med list reviewed: last tacrolimus entry (Astagraf 5 mg) ends 10/19/2071 in our system - ?? transplant pharmacy to verify what she is actually taking. Others: clopidogrel 75, simvastatin 20, metoprolol succinate 100, NTG spray, diphenhydramine 25 prn.
A: 1. Anxiety episode, ED w/u neg, GAD-7 7. 2. HbA1c unreliable -> need fructosamine or CGM to judge control. 3. Care gaps: interpreter not used in ED, med list stale, dental f/u (gingivitis).
P: (1) Call transplant coordinator Dana Rice re immunosuppression list, today. (2) Order fructosamine + draw with next trough. (3) Book Tigrinya interpreter (line ID 4471, interpreter Fitwi) for visit Mon 10/30. (4) SW referral - case worker Marguerite Oduya at Harbor Light Resettlement cc'd. (5) Dental referral, see below.
SMS thread pasted from the case worker's phone (she forwarded it): From: Marguerite Oduya <+1 612 555 0119> To: Beth Cook Date: Tue, Sep 5, 2073 7:48 AM dr dana says mahlet's husband works nights at Northgate Linen Services so call after 3pm. mrs Tesfaye (thats her fathers name, her chart name is Gebremariam, confusing I know) will need ride, I have the van MNL 4473 Sent from my iPhone ip 192.168.1.24
per prior note: >>> DISCHARGE SUMMARY 05/14/2071 Mahlet T. Gebremariam MRN E-0498127 Attending Dr Nwankwo. s/p deceased donor kidney tx 05/11/2071. meds on d/c tacrolimus ER 1 mg, clopidogrel, simvastatin, metoprolol, STOP lisinopril and amlodipine. Lives 418 Corliss Avenue, Apt 3B, Minneapolis. >>> Clinic 10/24/2072 (Dr Frost): HbA1c 2.8, BP 95/75, wt 84.7, LDL 90.5, GAD-7 1. Pt Mrs Haile brought in by husband. Tacrolimus continued. [Comment by B. Cook: 'Mrs Haile' = husband's surname, NOT pt] >>> Clinic 10/19/2071: HbA1c 3.2, BP 98/70, wt 82.7, glucose 92.0. Tacrolimus ER 5 mg capsule, lisinopril 10 daily <- old, stopped.
Dental: gingivitis flagged again, 11/2/2071 cleaning was last. Referral to dentist Dr Wen Cho at Southside Smile Dental, appt not yet booked.
Page 2 of 2 GEBREMARIAM, MAHLET E-0498127 Electronically signed by Beth Cook RN on 09/05/2073 11:26 Routed to: Lowell Frost, Dana Rice, Ruth Kowalczyk
